notes: TEST BUILD — PR #18 (stacked on PR #17), pushed to the updater at Michael's request. Settings -> Controls anywhere gains a live handle editor: Length, Thickness, Height on screen and Visibility sliders with a preview that updates as you drag, saved when you release. The overlay handle, the Home side tab and the pie's parked position all read the same saved values, and the handle window resizes itself the moment you change them. Everything from the 0.18.2 test build (two-window overlay, selection following the fan, rim baseline) is included.
